{{Quote|Well, I hear Kom'rk is out at Utapau, and Jaing's cannoned up and gone hiking with extreme prejudice in the Bakura sector.|[[Fi Skirata]]|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bakura sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] and could be reached along the [[Shiritoku Spur]]. It was invaded by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
